retain.guidance: Baseline ECHO/MUGA; every 12 weeks throughout combination and antibody-only continuation. About cycle 5, then 9, if 21-day dosing is uninterrupted; use time from the preceding cardiac assessment/first HER2 dose when cycles are delayed or route/phase changes. Cardiac concern may require 4–8-week checks or earlier clinical assessment. Do not reset the monitoring clock at maintenance or change automatically to six-monthly.
retain.interpretation_note: Cycle numbers are arithmetic illustrations, not additional NCCP cycle-specific requirements.

retain.guidance: NCCP specifies baseline and pre-cycle FBC/renal/liver tests, and consultant-directed disease monitoring. Existing weekly-paclitaxel wording correctly describes additional pre-dose counts as a local pathway. Do not present a universal CT timetable or tumour-marker-only decisions as NCCP requirements.

Single SC thigh injection; loading/reloading and maintenance have different duration and observation. Complete observation before taxane. Actual interval since IV or SC dual-HER2 dose controls reloading; a phase/route switch alone does not.

Taxane phase is low emetic potential, Phesgo alone minimal. Docetaxel dexamethasone and paclitaxel premedication belong to active taxane treatment. Do not automatically carry those scripts into maintenance. Existing docetaxel and weekly-paclitaxel premedication text matches the current regimen sources.

implement: 00796 LVEF hold explanation: include repeat within three weeks, with the minimum withholding/restart provisions separately attributed to the SmPC.
00797: add G-CSF consideration to the febrile-neutropenia finding; retain clinician selection rather than blanket prophylaxis.
In continuation-only dose notes remove language implying chemotherapy is still next in the visit.
Keep DEXA conditional on endocrine treatment/bone risk, and ECG/biomarkers conditional on the cardiology-risk plan; they are not additional Phesgo-specific every-cycle tests.
